## Design

### 2026-10-26: Date: October 26, 2026

**2h**

Date: October 26, 2026

In this session, I came up with an idea for a cabinet lighting system that includes multicolor lights and basic white light. I worked on the schematic layout and input all the necessary parts like the Xiao RP2040, resistors, RKGB LEDs, basic LEDS, a push button, and a potentiometer.  One thing that confused me was the different representation of the RGB labels, where some were labeled RBG or RGBK, which I recognized were used for different purposes, so I looked at the guide for a suggested option and went with the RKGB LEDS.  I also referred to the guide for the resistor values that work for my microcontroller. This concludes the part layout session and in the next session, I will be assigning the footprints and starting the actual PCB design.
